nl.title: WordPress heeft gedetecteerd dat je site een onveilige versie van PHP gebruikt
nl.excerpt: Los “onveilige PHP-versie” in WordPress op door PHP te upgraden in DirectAdmin.
nl.bodyHtml:
WordPress detecteert EOL PHP. Upgrade via PHP Version Select en test daarna plugins.

Voorbereiding

  • Domein
  • Beschikbare nieuwere PHP

Stappen

  1. Domain Setup → PHP Version Select
  2. Kies ondersteunde versie (8.x volgens beleid)
  3. Sla op
  4. Test site + wp-admin
  5. Update plugins/themes die falen

Controleren

  • Waarschuwing weg
  • Geen fatale errors

Tip: Lees plugin-eisen vóór jump van 7.4 naar 8.3.

Let op: Niet negeren: security-updates stoppen op EOL PHP.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: php-version; wp-critical.

en.title: WordPress has detected that your site is using an insecure version of PHP
en.excerpt: WordPress has detected that your site is using an insecure version of PHP: steps in WordPress (wp-admin) for WordPress, detected, site.
en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers WordPress has detected that your site is using an insecure version of PHP. You work in WordPress (wp-admin), focusing on WordPress, detected, site — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to WordPress (wp-admin)
  • Focus of this article: WordPress, detected, site
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Open WordPress (wp-admin) and look specifically for settings around WordPress, detected, site.
  2. Take a backup (Installatron or panel) before changing WordPress.
  3. Sign in to /wp-admin and open Plugins, Themes, Settings, Media or WooCommerce — whatever fits detected.
  4. Apply the change; on a critical error isolate via File Manager (rename plugins).
  5. Clear caches and test the pages that touch site.
  6. Document what you changed around WordPress, detected, site (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for WordPress, detected, site matches “WordPress has detected that your site is using an insecure version of PHP”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside WordPress detected site
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get WordPress, detected, site right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if WordPress, detected, site touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: WordPress (wp-admin), backups, tickets.
